## Description
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md lines 135, 137, 2062 set vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID via PATCH/POST so per-branch-review.yml can fetch the session branch for per-story delta scoping. per-branch-review.yml was deleted in commit 4b18d2d644 (story 20d7-09d6). This Phase A network call is now dead code.

## Impact
P3 — noise/confusion for operators, wasted network call per sprint session.

## Fix
Remove the SPRINT_SESSION_ID setup block from sprint SKILL.md Phase A, or redirect it to serve a new consumer if one exists.

## Found By
completion-verifier during story 20d7-09d6 closure
data.title: sprint SKILL.md Phase A sets SPRINT_SESSION_ID for deleted per-branch-review.yml (dead code)
